novel_features.name: Stale branches
novel_features.description: Find idle or expired branches across every project from the local mirror (run sync first), with delete commands for non-default branches.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced branch activity, expiration and endpoint data that no single API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before cleanup to see which preview branches are safe to remove.

novel_features.name: Fleet tree
novel_features.description: See every org, project, branch and compute in one hierarchy from the local mirror (run sync first).
novel_features.rationale: Built from a local join of synced orgs, projects, branches and endpoints instead of dozens of API calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to orient in an unfamiliar Neon account in one call.

novel_features.name: Usage trends
novel_features.description: Track compute, storage and transfer per project with period-over-period deltas; on plans without consumption history (below Launch/Scale) it uses per-sync snapshots (basis: sync-snapshots).
novel_features.rationale: Requires consumption history stored locally across syncs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for questions about how usage changed over time.

novel_features.name: Usage top
novel_features.description: Rank projects by compute, storage, transfer or written data; on plans without consumption history it ranks period-to-date totals from sync snapshots (basis: sync-snapshots).
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find which project drove a bill spike.

novel_features.name: Operation wait
novel_features.description: Block until a branch's async operations finish; exits 0 when done, 6 if an operation failed, 8 on timeout.
novel_features.rationale: Chains operation polling the API leaves to the caller.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in CI or agent flows before connecting to a freshly created branch.

novel_features.name: Preview branch up
novel_features.description: Create a real branch (or reuse an existing one by name), wait until ready and print its connection string; --expires applies only to newly created branches.
novel_features.rationale: Idempotent find-or-create plus wait plus connection URI is several API calls with polling.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for per-PR databases; safe to re-run.

novel_features.name: Branch prune
novel_features.description: Preview idle or expired branches to delete (from the local mirror); --yes actually deletes them, always skipping default and protected branches.
novel_features.rationale: Uses the same local selection as stale with safe-by-default deletion.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after stale to actually clean up.

novel_features.name: Compute audit
novel_features.description: Flag computes that never scale to zero, have fixed autoscaling, or are oversized on non-default branches, from the local mirror (run sync first).
novel_features.rationale: Scans synced endpoint settings across all projects.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find the cheapest cost wins in a Neon fleet.

narrative.headline: Neon API commands in one static binary, plus a local fleet mirror for stale-branch cleanup, usage trends and compute audits.
narrative.value_prop: Manage Neon projects, branches, computes, roles and databases from the terminal with agent-native JSON and no Node runtime. Sync your account locally to get stale, tree, usage trend and compute audit, and use preview up and wait for per-PR branch workflows.

quickstart.comment: Check configuration without touching the network
Mirror projects, branches and endpoints locally
See the whole fleet at once

troubleshoots.fix: Create an API key in the Neon console (Account settings > API keys), then: export NEON_API_KEY=napi_xxx

troubleshoots.symptom: 404 not allowed for organization API keys
troubleshoots.fix: Org API keys cannot call /users/me, /regions or /api_keys; use projects list and organizations commands instead

troubleshoots.symptom: 423 Locked when creating or deleting a branch
troubleshoots.fix: Another operation is running: neon-pp-cli wait --branch pr-123 --project-id lucky-sun-123456, then retry

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to manage Neon control-plane resources: projects, branches, computes, roles, databases, operations and consumption. It suits per-PR branch automation, fleet audits and cost questions across many projects.
anti_triggers: Running SQL queries against a database; use psql with the connection string
Schema migrations; use your migration tool
Billing invoices and payment methods; use the Neon console
